messages:
morgan: Heads-up — saw an incident where a hedged retry to upstream caused chunk reordering and caller-visible garbled stream. Repro steps and notes below.

tayler: Can you paste logs / what upstream (http/2, grpc?)

morgan: grpc bidi over h2. Edge hedged to another upstream when conn latency spiked; new conn returned chunks that overlapped sequence ranges -> responses interleaved out of order. Snippet from edge trace: 

morgan: ```
EGRESS: req_id=abc123 hedge=2 -> upstream-a
INGRESS: chunk_meta={offset:0,len:1024,partial:1}
INGRESS: chunk_meta={offset:1024,len:512,partial:0} (from upstream-b)
// client saw: 1024..512 then 0..1024 -> garbled merge
```

sam: Proposal: add a per-request monotonic chunk seq at gateway boundary (header `X-RW-Chunk-Seq: <n>`) so the gateway can reorder/ignore duplicates before emitting to client. Simple buffer + sliding window.

anu: Alternative: per-request ephemeral stream-uuid + chunk-hash dedupe. That is stateless dedupe by content but doesn't help for reordering where chunks must be merged in order.

morgan: Tradeoffs: seq header -> deterministic ordering, needs small in-flight buffer (O(n) entries per request). Hash dedupe -> no ordering guarantee, cheaper memory but higher CPU and not sufficient for partial-chunk merges.

tayler: Hybrid idea: seq header + `final` flag. Make resequencing opt-in per route (`stream.resequencing: true`) to avoid global costs. Also include `origin-id` so we can prefer chunks from primary upstream.

sam: POC sketch:

```
// egress side (gateway)
seq = req.ctx.seq_counter++
setHeader("X-RW-Chunk-Seq", seq)
// ingress (replay/resume)
if (route.resequencing) buffer.insert(seq, chunk)
while (buffer.has(next_seq)) emit(buffer.pop(next_seq))
```

sam: We also need a bounded buffer (slot/byte budget) and eviction policy (drop-oldest or backpressure).

morgan: Perf concerns: extra header + buffer ops add CPU + memory. Need microbench for tail latency and memory pressure at 99p. Also interaction with backpressure: if buffer fills we must signal upstream or fail hedged attempts earlier.

anu: Agree. Also fairness: don't let one large stream hog resequencer. Add per-request and per-route budgets and expose metrics (#slots_used, bytes_buffered, drops).

tayler: Ops compatibility note: clients that sign headers (sigv4-like) may break if new headers are signed. We should add `X-RW-Chunk-Seq` to the unsigned headers list or sign it in gateway-only context. Documentable config.

sam: Implementation plan:
1) Spec header semantics: `seq` (u64), `final` (bool), `origin-id`
2) Route opt-in + per-route budget knobs
3) POC in gateway proxy + perf harness that simulates hedged retries/dual upstreams
4) Canary test region with low traffic
5) Roll to prod with metrics and alerting

morgan: +1. I'll draft RFC with envelope semantics and budget defaults. Will prototype in proxy-v2 this week. Anyone want to pair on sim harness tomorrow?

tayler: I'll join for the harness.

anu: I can own budget knobs and dashboarding (memory/counter metrics).

ops-bot: created ticket RINF-4321 for POC + perf job <https://phabricator/internal/RINF-4321>

morgan: cool, assigning RINF-4321 to morgan/sam/tayler/anu. Will add notes to RFC. :thumbsup:
